report:
Source review: Reviewed the complete claim, whole semantic_spec.rs fragment, sole implementation entry and sole annotated test sage_meta::todo::solver_local_index_firewall. All evidence is explicitly TODO. The implementation comment declares the private trait-keyed tracked index and edit firewall unimplemented, with module scanning instead. This accounts for missing stable crate-owned identity, private tracked-map storage and exclusive keyed tracked readers; it does not establish those properties. The test body contains only TODO comments and no behavioral assertions.

The deferred matrix explicitly distinguishes map rebuilding and cheap keyed lookup from impl-header lowering, canonical solving, normalization and body execution. Its unrelated-trait and impl-body edit cases require equality to stop downstream work, covering backdating and unchanged signature buckets; stable identity across unrelated edits is explicitly included. Relevant-trait and global-hazard changes supply the contrasting invalidation scenarios. Prerequisites are implementing the declared tracked index/lookup boundary and instrumented persistent edit tests that distinguish these execution stages and compare identities/results. These remain justified, visible deferrals; no part of the firewall is approved as implemented or behaviorally tested. No additional edits to this accounting are needed.

Baseline: Independently verified exact equality of current whole-file source against both historical implementation_sources and test_sources, of claim text and implementation metadata, and inspected the sole historical/current test entry: only its source moved from inline metadata into a test fragment. Reassessed the supplied prior rationale against current evidence rather than treating its decision as execution evidence. No implementation helpers are relied upon beyond the initial captured file.

Execution: Personally ran review start and Python snapshot comparisons; no tests or workspace build were run by this reviewer. The coordinator reports 321 sage-meta functional tests and cargo build passing; that is separate reported baseline execution and does not prove this deferred firewall. This report is submitted through review record.
